figures.Fig25.10: The floods in parts of Pakistan in 2022 (photograph). Photographs are not reproduced and need no redrawing.

findings: The book gives CO2 80%, methane 11%, N2O 6% and fluorinated gases 3% as each gas's contribution to global warming; shares of this size usually describe emissions by CO2 equivalent (and vary by country). The lesson attributes them and adds a note, flagged.
The photograph is of the 2022 floods while the Tidbit describes June 2025 floods; the Tidbit's figures are attributed to the book. 'draught' is read as drought.

Owner rule (2026-10-21): the English lesson carries only the book's content. Our explanations, notes on the print, self-check questions with their answers, the recap, 3D models and figures the book does not print are in the Roman Urdu lesson only; where the book's own Quick Check or Brain Teaser questions are given, the English lesson lists them without answers.
